scripts.generate: prisma generate --config prisma.directory.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma.user.config.ts && node scripts/embed-migrations.mjs && node scripts/check-defaults.mjs
scripts.migrate:diff:directory: prisma migrate diff --config prisma.directory.config.ts --from-migrations migrations/directory --to-schema prisma/directory.prisma --script
scripts.migrate:diff:user: prisma migrate diff --config prisma.user.config.ts --from-migrations migrations/user --to-schema prisma/user.prisma --script
